about: Conformance cases for the help center prose and image rules. Two implementations must pass every case: `gkdocs lint` (src/lint/rules.ts, run by src/lint/conformance.test.ts) and the gkhc-docs-authoring skill's Python port (scripts/prose_rules.py in GK-WP-HC-Design, run by its own test). `rules` pins the rule set and each rule's severity; a case's `expect` gives the number of findings per rule for its body (rules it does not name are not checked). Each body is a page body: the runner adds a frontmatter block. Edit this file with the rule, never only one implementation; the skill's copy is synced by GK-WP-HC-Design `skills/standards_sync.py`.
